facts.text: Sit down, eat, and I'll tell you about Adrian's turkey. Second helpings are always on the house.
facts.why: No source I opened mentions a turkey story at Adrian's. Rocky tells stories about his past to the diners, so the rest fits.
facts.fix: Sit down, eat, and I'll tell you about Adrian. Second helpings are always on the house.

fix_note.text: Sit down, eat, and I'll tell you about Adrian. Second helpings are always on the house.

facts.text: Spider Rico eating on the house
facts.why: Wikipedia lists Spider Rico as Rocky's former opponent and current employee at Adrian's.

facts.text: Punchy, the dog from the pound
facts.why: Rocky takes Steps and Marie to a dog pound, then they bail Punchy out and the dog is named in that scene.

facts.text: Raised to Adrian, every year on the anniversary.
facts.why: Rocky and Paulie mark Adrian's anniversary and Rocky visits her grave, but no toast or yearly raised glass is shown.

facts.text: Lucky Seven Tiger Bar hot honey wings
facts.why: No transcript or plot source gives the bar name 'Lucky Seven Tiger Bar'. Marie is a barmaid Rocky finds late one night.

facts.text: Little Marie runs the front of house now, and the cheesecake
facts.why: Marie is a barmaid and a single mum who turned down the restaurant job. She never runs Adrian's front of house. Rocky walked her home as a girl.
facts.fix: Little Marie, the girl Rocky once walked home, and the cheesecake
